serena.$comment: Semantic code navigation and persistent project memories. Uses installed binary — NOT uvx (too slow, exceeds MCP timeout).

context7.$comment: Up-to-date documentation and code examples via Context7

playwright.$comment: Headed Chrome with `--isolated --storage-state ~/.claude/mcp-storageState.json`. Parallel-safe (every session gets its own ephemeral profile) and all sessions start authenticated by preloading the storage-state file. Seed via the MCP tool `browser_storage_state` from inside a running session (NOT external `npx playwright codegen` — that path is flaky on macOS and was the trap in PR #354's first try). See process-rules.md::playwright-mcp-config-cycle for the full failure-mode history.

playwright-isolated.$comment: Ephemeral headed Chrome for one-off CSS/visual checks where login state is not needed. Window is visible (not headless) so you can see what is happening; profile is in-memory and discarded on close. Tracks @latest — the original 0.0.70 pin caused the months-long codegen-seed failure mode (process-rules.md::playwright-mcp-config-cycle anti-pattern 8). Note: @latest dropped `--browser chromium`; valid values are chrome|firefox|webkit|msedge.

codeindex.$comment: Graph-powered code intelligence. Install: npm i -g klai-private/tools/codeindex-1.3.56.tgz && codeindex analyze

grafana.$comment: AI agent access to Grafana dashboards, metrics queries, and alerts. Read-only. VictoriaLogs queries use the dedicated victorialogs MCP instead.

victorialogs.$comment: LogsQL queries against VictoriaLogs. Requires SSH tunnel: ./scripts/victorialogs-tunnel.sh. Binary must be at ~/bin/mcp-victorialogs (Mac) or %USERPROFILE%\bin\mcp-victorialogs.exe (Windows). Set VICTORIALOGS_BASIC_AUTH_B64 in shell profile.
